issue.title: ability to pass a regex to add_passthru

summary.text: A test reproduced the missing regex support in add_passthru (failing before the fix and passing after), and the tests fail when the fix is reverted or broken, with no regressions or breaking inputs found. The behaviour comparison for add_passthru, _on_request and start did not finish, so a reviewer should check by hand how the new regex matching changes passthru decisions for existing string pref…
